text: First of all, this app is criminally underrated compared to other similar apps that are more popular for some reason. The app runs smoothly (unlike another similar app), doesn't occupy lots of storage, doesn't have Ads, has a simple design, and it's quite intuitive. You can tell it was developed by people who understand how executive dysfunction works. I might pay for the Premium version in the future, but the free version has what I would consider essential to make the app usable and useful.

text: Possuo a assinatura Pro e sou bastante satisfeito com a compra. O aplicativo tem um misto equilibrado entre simplicidade e diversidade de configurações, que me motiva a continuar usando sem me deixar sobrecarregado com informação. Muitas vezes acabo enrolando com as atividades, mesmo com o aplicativo, mas ter até as coisas mais simples listadas como afazeres em uma rotina (que pode ser flexibilizada!) tem sido de grande auxílio no dia a dia.

text: The only app that has actually helped me! I couldn't find the motivation to do things, even what I really wanted to start doing. The way this app is designed, creates a safe no pressure environment that made me actually enjoy and look forward to starting my new routines and habits. I'm really thankful and I feel really lucky that I've come across this app.
